objective: Integrate the 大模型与逻辑方法 lectures into the AI product course as a rigorous, story-led and instructor-ready knowledge foundation.
primaryDeliverable: The canonical Markdown course modules and their deterministic complete-book output.

confirmedDecisions.decision: Reorganize the ten source chapters into three AI-facing foundation chapters: propositions and boundaries; reasoning chains and falsification; samples, experiments and causal claims.
Use telecom complaints, member coupons and boiler temperature review as three progressive anchor cases; retain the other twenty-one business cases as industry extensions.

Use most of the useful oral prose from all fifty lectures after de-duplication, fact checking and editing; extract concise points while retaining teachable narration as the body beneath each numbered knowledge node.
Apply one course-wide hierarchy of chapter, section and knowledge point with no fourth numbered level; keep stable internal IDs separate from display numbering.

Audit every legacy image. Retain useful, clear and attributable images; redraw logic diagrams when needed; retrieve authoritative or openly reusable real-world figures; use real AI inputs, outputs and runtime screenshots for AI evidence.

Every major chapter ends with a comprehensive teaching case. Theory chapters use complete materials, prompts, results and analysis without requiring a new web app; the twenty-four industry cases remain the product-level runnable applications.
Resolve reversible editorial, source-selection and implementation details autonomously; ask only when a decision changes scope, safety, architecture or acceptance.

structure: logic foundation: propositions, facts, opinions and boundaries
logic foundation: relations, reasoning chains, contradiction, counterexamples and falsification
logic foundation: induction, sampling, experiments, comparison, correlation, regression and causality
writingRules: Begin each major concept with a concrete life story or observable situation when the source supports one.
Move from story to principle, then to an AI example, and close each major chapter with a comprehensive case.
Do not transplant the fifty-lesson source order or preserve repeated course-host phrasing.
Do not add repetitive instructor instructions, delivery-process narration or evidence bureaucracy to the teaching body.
Do not create headings merely to hold one sentence; every numbered node must contain a coherent teachable unit.
Distinguish source facts, computed results, inferences and decisions without turning those distinctions into repetitive labels.
Use Chinese labels and explanations for diagrams that enter the main course.
visualRules: A retained source image must have a clear instructional purpose, acceptable resolution and recoverable provenance.
An external figure must be traced to an authoritative or openly reusable source and recorded in the source ledger.
A redrawn diagram must preserve the supported concept and remain editable when practical.
Generated imagery may illustrate a story but may not stand in for a real chart, source document, model response or application screenshot.
acceptance: The complete book follows the new numbered hierarchy without breaking existing case IDs, routes, datasets or screenshots.
All fifty source lectures are mapped to retained, merged or omitted content with a reason; most useful oral narration is incorporated rather than summarized away.
Each major chapter contains a story, a rigorous principle explanation, an AI example and a comprehensive teaching case.
The three anchor cases visibly deepen across the course without duplicating full applications.
Every retained or new non-runtime visual has a recorded source or redraw basis; AI results use current real artifacts.
The final Markdown passes composition, structure, source, link, style, dataset and case verification.
No PowerPoint expansion is on the critical path for this phase.
